Configuration parameters for constructing a build configuration instance.

## Signature

```typescript
export interface BuildConfigurationConstructorParameters
```

## Remarks

This interface defines the required configuration for creating an instance of [BuildConfiguration](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/buildconfiguration)<!-- -->. Most properties are mandatory except for the optional <code>templateBuildConfigurationName</code> and <code>matrixParameters</code>, which are only needed for template-generated configurations created from matrix expansion.

The parameters provide the configuration with its identity (name, optional template name), the JSON configuration definition, access to the parent collection for shared resources, and optional matrix parameter values for template-generated configurations.
